title: Fault Detection and Bit-Error Rate Diagnostics in Optical Wireless Links Using Edge-AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.21402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) systems provide high-bandwidth, spatially secure, and RF-interference-free digital transmission. However, direct free-space optical links suffer from extreme sensitivity to line-of-sight disruptions, optical attenuation, high ambient light saturation, and transmitter-receiver misalignment. Traditional channel diagnostic frameworks rely on external computing nodes or cloud-based processing, which introduces severe diagnostic latency and reduces edge node autonomy. This paper presents an autonomous, self-diagnosing optical wireless receiver node that integrates physical-layer signal telemetry extraction with an on-device TinyML classification engine. translated_title: 基于边缘AI的光无线链路故障检测与误码率诊断
translated_abstract: 光无线通信（OWC）系统能够提供高带宽、空间安全且无射频干扰的数字传输。然而，直接自由空间光链路对视距中断、光衰减、高环境光饱和以及收发器失准等因素极为敏感。传统的信道诊断框架依赖于外部计算节点或基于云的处理，这会引入严重的诊断延迟并降低边缘节点的自主性。本文提出了一种自主、自诊断的光无线接收节点，该节点将物理层信号遥测提取与设备端TinyML分类引擎相集成。该接收器基于ESP32-S3微控制器构建，采用5样本多数投票机制恢复1000比特/秒的开关键控（OOK）数字有效载荷，同时实时提取信道特征：误码率（BER）、接收信号电压等。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于ESP32-S3微控制器与TinyML的自主自诊断光无线接收节点，可在设备端实时提取误码率等信道特征并实现故障检测，无需依赖云端或外部计算资源。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an autonomous, self-diagnosing optical wireless receiver node built on an ESP32-S3 microcontroller with an on-device TinyML engine, enabling real-time extraction of channel features such as BER and fault detection without relying on cloud or external computing.
